name: speak
description: Text-to-speech alerts for local agents — say 'done' out loud. Engine auto-selects: espeak-ng, espeak, flite, festival, or pico2wave+aplay. 'backends' reports what's installed.
use_when: alerting the user audibly with text-to-speech

args.name: say [text|--file path] [--rate wpm] [--voice v]
args.description: Speak text, a file, or stdin aloud.

args.name: backends
args.description: Report which TTS engines exist and which would be used.

env.SPEAK_ENGINE: Force engine: espeak-ng, espeak, flite, festival, pico2wave.

stdout: JSON {spoken, engine, chars} or backend status.
notes: Setup: sudo dnf install espeak-ng (or espeak / flite / festival).
